title: Mass-measure bound on a compact set for Z = T + Y|_U near the set (parent step 4; Simon 7.2.4 (10))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let U′ ⊆ U be open and let E ⊆ U′ be compact. Let T, Z ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n). Let R and R_Z be integer multiplicity representations in U (IMRep U n) with R.Represents T and R_Z.Represents Z, and let R_Y be one in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) with R_Y.Represents Y. Suppose Z(ω) = T(ω) + Y(ιω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ U′, where ιω = testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω is ω regarded as a test form on ℝ^P. Then μ_{R_Z}(E) ≤ μ_R(E) + μ_{R_Y}(E) in [0, ∞], where μ_{R′} := R′.measure = θ′Hⁿ⌞M′ is the weight of R′ = (M′, θ′, ξ′).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U U' E : Set (Euclid P)) (T Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R RZ : IMRep U n) (RY : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → IsOpen U' → U' ⊆ U → IsCompact E → E ⊆ U' → R.Represents T → RZ.Represents Z → RY.Represents Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ U' → Z ω = T ω + Y (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω)) → RZ.measure E ≤ R.measure E + RY.measure E
